title: Three mock tool bars give one key to two different tools
goal: On three screens of the design study, two buttons sitting in the same tool bar claim the same keyboard letter, so one of them can never be reached from the keyboard. Pick a letter for each so every tool in a bar has its own.
notes: Found while fixing the redline Arrow key. Same-bar collisions: docs/design/mocks/pages/image.html Patch (P) sits next to Pen (P) - Photoshop files Patch under J with the healing group, and Heal (J) already exists in the corpus, so the fix is probably Patch -> J as a grouped slot. iconography.html Marquee (M) next to Measure (M) - the app already resolved this one, Tool.shortcutKey has measure on I because M is the Photoshop marquee. ui-prototype.html Connect (X) next to Swap foreground and background (X). Detection script: grep title="...(K)" per page and group by K. Note app-shell.html and lang-toolbars.html also flag but are false positives - they render several DIFFERENT tool bars on one page as a gallery, so C=Crop in an image bar vs C=Component insert in a UI bar is mode-dependent, not a collision. Canonical letters now live in Sources/PhotonzCore/Tools.swift Tool.shortcutKey and the rule is written up in docs/design/mocks/shared/AGENTS.md.
acceptance: No tool bar in the design study has two controls whose key hint is the same letter
The letters that change still follow Photoshop wherever Photoshop has the same tool
The keyboard legend page lists whatever letters changed
